wisp.goal.name: goal
wisp.goal.placeholder: all tests pass and it works on a phone
wisp.goal.placeholderLong: all tests pass and the page works on a phone
wisp.goal.hint: wisp checks after every round, reading the code and running the tests, and sends it back with what’s missing.
wisp.goal.goalOn: Goal: the task keeps going until “Done when” holds. Click to launch without one.
wisp.goal.goalOff: Goal: keep going until a condition holds (wisp checks after every round)
wisp.goal.noGoal: No goal: Done when is empty
wisp.goal.judges.intro: Each one checks the goal on its own, reading the code, and votes. The goal is met only when enough of them agree.
wisp.goal.judges.tip: Judges: have agents on other harnesses (or your crew) check the goal, and decide by All, Majority or Any
wisp.goal.judges.empty: No judges: wisp’s own quick check decides. Add two or three on different harnesses for a second opinion that doesn’t share the agent’s blind spots.
wisp.goal.judges.addHarnessHint: Pick its model and thinking level
wisp.goal.judges.oneDecides: One judge decides. Add another to vote.
wisp.goal.judges.addTwo: Add two or more to vote.
wisp.goal.vote.allHint: Every judge must say it’s met
wisp.goal.vote.majorityHint: More than half must say it’s met
wisp.goal.vote.anyHint: One judge saying it’s met is enough
wisp.goal.checks.title: Goal checks
wisp.goal.checks.own: wisp’s own look at the work, each round
wisp.goal.run.title: Goal check
wisp.goal.run.gone: This check isn’t kept any more. A goal keeps its last 50.
wisp.goal.run.end.timeout: It ran out of time, so it voted for nothing. This is what it got done.
wisp.goal.run.end.stopped: It was stopped before it voted. This is what it got done.
wisp.goal.run.end.error: Its run failed before it voted.
wisp.goal.run.end.nojson: It answered, but its answer had no vote in it.
wisp.goal.run.end.interrupted: wisp restarted during this check, so it never voted.
